product_metadata.title: TAIYALOO E17 LED Bulb Dimmable, 5W Microwave Oven Bulb, Natural White 4000K, 40W Halogen Bulb Replacement for Microwave, Over Stove Appliance, Range Hood, E17 Intermediate Base (2 Pack)
features: Energy Saving E17 LED Bulb: Emit 450 lumen of brightness by using only 5w, equivalent to 40 watt halogen bulb, save 90% on electric energy. Good dimming compatible, smooth dimming from 0-100%.

Excellent Performance: Instant on without delay, zero flicker and no buzzing sound. Built-in ceramic materials, less heat output, long lasting and safer to use, save your hassle and cost on maintenance.
4000K Natural White LED Appliance Bulb: Creating a bright, pleasant and natural atmosphere for you. CRI> 80Ra, present object color vividly and clearly; makes your food look yummy when cooking.
E17 Intermediate Base Bulb: Suitable for microwave oven, stove, ceiling fan light or other appliance light fixtures with E17 socket (Pls don't Install the bulb inside microwave oven).
Friendly Customer Service: Provide you 24-month after-sale customer service for them. If any question,pls click "contact the seller", we will be in touch within 24 hours. Buy with confidence!
